meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 你说「把这份目录、链接、笔记或刚才做的事变成技能」,它会读取这些材料,提炼出可重复的步骤和踩过的坑,写出或更新 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md。
howto.when: 当你说出 “/learn”、“learn this”、“turn this into a skill” 等指令,或要求把某目录、链接、笔记做成技能、改进已有技能时触发。

say.note: 把刚才对话里的流程提炼成新技能。

say.text: 把 https://example.com/docs 做成一个技能
say.note: 会抓取该页面并写出使用技能。

say.text: 更新 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 会读取现有 SKILL.md 就地改进。

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the work just done in this chat into a reusable skill, or refines an existing one. It reads the source, distills the repeatable steps and gotchas, then writes .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers on '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill' and similar phrases, or when asked to capture a directory, URL or notes as a skill, or to improve an existing one.

say_en.note: Distills this conversation into a skill.
Fetches the page and writes a usage skill.
Reads the existing SKILL.md and refines it in place.
